title: consolidate API-like interfaces
symptom: The issue reports that xDrip has several API-like interfaces (SendXdripBroadcast, NSClientReceiver, ExternalStatusBroadcastReceiver, XdripWebService) that are chaotic and could be consolidated into one intent broadcast service. It also notes that some endpoints only semi work, e.g., /tasker/snooze works but /tasker/restart collector does not.
evidence_quote: I'll offer to rework/streamline the preferences hierarchy so they're all more user-friendly, but if we can consolidate down to one "intent broadcast" service, that would be much less chaotic.
